title: Session-start hook runs publish
goal: kbgit.py publish --hook runs from an async SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json beside red-pipeline (timeout 60, as it): in a clone with a publish remote it publishes when the checks pass and the projection is ahead of the public home, prints only a refusal or a failed push, and exits 0 without a publish remote and on every outcome; TestPublishHook in _tools/test_kbpublic.py covers the three cases
